description: Task specification for a 35-module release-review workspace. Every requirement already holds in the broken fixture. The faults are a remote nominal-type mismatch inside the active pipeline and ambient authority hidden in an otherwise unrelated view.

brief.task:
A 35-module AIL workspace is broken. Make `ailc publish` succeed on it while
the task specification below still holds. The workspace already exists; you
repair AIL source.
rules:
`contracts.ail` declares the public types and is immutable. The harness rejects
   any write to it. Weakening a type is not a solution.

The capability environment is empty and stays empty. There is no capability
   configuration file to add.
brief.feedback_ail:
FEEDBACK POLICY (arm ail): `check` and `publish` return the AIL compiler's
own output verbatim: diagnostic codes, spans, `expected.*` / `actual.*`
details, and declaration references. Treat that output as the only source
of truth about what is wrong. Do not guess at causes the compiler did not report.

immutable_reason: the immutable public type surface of this workspace

required_declarations.requirement: a module named contracts exists
a module named workflow exists
a module named batch exists
a module named transport exists
a module named tests exists
record ReleaseRequest keeps value and origin Text fields in order
required_declarations.pattern: record ReleaseRequest \{ value: Text; origin: Text; \}

required_declarations.requirement: variant ReviewSignal keeps Clear, Blank, Unsafe, External in order
required_declarations.pattern: variant ReviewSignal \{ Clear; Blank; Unsafe; External; \}

required_declarations.requirement: variant ReleaseDecision keeps Approve, Reject, and Hold Text payloads in order
record ReleaseReport keeps decision then note
required_declarations.pattern: record ReleaseReport \{ decision: ReleaseDecision; note: Text; \}

required_declarations.requirement: tests.release_batch keeps its exact list-bounded signature
tests.release_batch still calls transport.dispatch
transport.dispatch still calls batch.review_all
batch.review_all still maps workflow.review over requests in order
workflow.review still copies the request
workflow.review still routes a review signal
workflow.review still restores the routed signal
workflow.review still applies the decision matrix
workflow.review still builds the report
a blank value still routes to Blank
a value with control characters still routes to Unsafe
a missing origin still routes to External
every other request still routes to Clear
Clear still decides Approve carrying request.value
Blank still decides Reject blank
Unsafe still decides Reject unsafe
External still decides Hold carrying request.origin
report_builder.build still constructs ReleaseReport
workspace_value remains available for workspace presentation
